name: Claude Code
cross_check: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog — confirm the npm dist-tag has a matching changelog entry before syncing content
release_notes: Use the official changelog page directly; each entry there is already scoped to what shipped in that release.
gotchas: npm dist-tags.latest can land ahead of the changelog page by a few hours — cross-check before syncing content, not just the version number.

Two independent version numbers are tracked on this placemat: the template version (this page's own structure, bumped only on structural/visual redesigns) and the CC release version (content, updated on every sync). Only the CC release version drives the header's 'As of release' tag and the changelog's Content/Release sections.

The standalone claude-code-placemat repo used class="new" and an <!-- added:vX.Y.Z --> comment to mark recent items directly in index.html. That convention is gone — this template computes 'new' per visitor at runtime from changes.json (house AGENTS.md); never write class="new" into index.html.
JSON settings that only apply in managed/enterprise policy files belong in the 'Managed & Enterprise' group of the Settings (JSON) card, not in the general settings groups.

docs.slash_commands and docs.settings were stale (the vendor renamed /docs/en/slash-commands to /docs/en/commands, and /docs/en/settings is now a precedence overview rather than the exhaustive key reference, which moved to /docs/en/settings-reference) — fixed while building the Task 5 inventory (2026-09-13).

The commands reference table only lists the primary form of a command; several real commands are documented only as an 'Alias:'/'Aliases:' note in another row's cell (e.g. /undo, /checkpoint, /proactive, /settings, /checkup) — the inventory.slash array folds those in too.

v2.1.304 (2026-10-19) is the first release since v2.1.299 with a full itemized changelog, and this sync's re-extraction (2026-10-20) diffed commands.md, settings-reference.md and hooks.md directly against the inventory once more, finding no new slash command, settings key, or hook event name — every genuinely new field in this release's Added/Changed/Fixed lists turned out to be a mods-API field (decider: "person", e.isReadOnly on tool.check, settings.read rewriting merged settings), an org-level GitHub Code Review admin feature, a VSCode-only change, or a pure internal/perf fix, none of which this placemat tracks. What this sync did add: four already-real, already-vendor-confirmed items that had never gotten a placemat row before — /auto-mode-setup (in commands.md since v2.1.228, confirmed verbatim: drafts autoMode.environment entries from your project and recent sessions) and /artifacts (in commands.md since v2.1.208: list/attach/open/copy-link for artifacts you own or that are shared with you) both into card-slash-tools; CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC (in env-vars.md since v2.1.287: caps -p/Agent SDK transcript file growth after compaction) and CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW (in env-vars.md, now explicitly stating its k/M-suffix support 'requires v2.1.304 or later') both into card-env. Also added notes on existing rows per the house rule against extending summaries: /claude-api's managed-agents-secure subcommand (confirmed only via the v2.1.304 changelog, not yet in commands.md's own /claude-api bracket list, which still shows managed-agents-onboard as of this fetch), /reload-skills (compaction now resends the full list on its own, so this command sends only new/changed skills), -w/--worktree (now asks before removing the worktree+branch at exit when HEAD is detached or on another branch), and alwaysLoad (cloud sessions' first turn no longer waits on claude.ai-synced plugins' stdio MCP servers unless this is set).

v2.1.305 (2026-10-20) added sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces, confirmed verbatim in its changelog entry (lets sandboxed commands on Linux create user namespaces for Chromium or rootless podman, at the cost of the sandbox's file protections) and not yet in settings-reference.md as of this fetch — given its first placemat row in the Key JSON Settings group, next to the other sandbox.* chips. CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS is confirmed directly in env-vars.md ('Requires Claude Code v2.1.305 or later') — not inventoried (env vars aren't tracked in inventory.settings), but given its own row in the Env Vars card next to its CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_WAIT_MS and CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS siblings. v2.1.305 also changed allowedMcpServers to exempt a managed-mcp.json stdio server using ${VAR} expansion only in its env field from allowlist filtering — a narrower case of the v2.1.259 exemption for entries with no ${VAR} expansion at all, which an entry using ${VAR} outside env still doesn't qualify for (settings-reference.md's own allowedMcpServers section already reflects both as of the 2026-10-21 fetch) — rewritten into the existing deniedMcpServers row's v2.1.259 note rather than stacked as a separate one, since the two described states would otherwise read as contradicting each other; changed /artifacts's delete confirmation so y/n no longer answer it (only 1/Enter, 2, and Esc do) — the existing note on the /artifacts row was rewritten rather than extended, per the house rule against letting a note go stale; and improved /usage (each warning is now a one-line, source-named fix applied with f, also surfaced in /doctor) and /remote-control (pressing w during spawn-mode setup now says the mode is saved for the folder, and a later claude remote-control start using that saved mode says where it came from) — both recorded as new notes on their existing rows. v2.1.306 (2026-10-21) was a bug-fix-only release (claude -p inside cloud sessions wrongly reporting 'Not logged in', and an avoidable compaction in sessions with many MCP tools) with nothing placemat-relevant, same treatment as v2.1.303/294/291: the release tag still advanced to v2.1.306 per the 'runs ahead of the changelog' allowance, and changelog.html gets no v2.1.306 entry.
